{{Vanilla|Glass}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Glass''' is a transparent block. In [[Matcha Flavoured]] it is fired in a [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]] from [[sand]], red sand or [[quartz]], sold in bulk, and used for cheap [[Glass Bottle|glass bottles]] and light blocks.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
Sand, red sand or quartz fired in a mud kiln becomes glass (5 seconds); the vanilla furnace recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/kiln/glass_from_smoking_sand.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>

=== Other sources ===
{{Sources}}
Mining sand, red sand or a [[Quartz Deposit|quartz deposit]] with the [[Adamant equipment|adamant]] tool intrinsic drops glass directly.

=== Trading ===
The [[Mason]] sells 3 bulk glass for 1 [[obol]] at the apprentice level; each unpacks into 64 glass.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/mason/2/glass.json}}</ref>

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
* One glass makes 3 [[Glass Bottle|glass bottles]].
* A [[stonecutter]] cuts glass into 4 glass panes, and stained glass into stained panes.
* Glass is used in [[Phosphor lamps|phosphor lamps]], [[Electric Lamp|electric lamps]] and the spyglass.
* Glass is in the pickaxe's mineable list.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/tags/block/mineable/pickaxe.json}}</ref>
